facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

control_failures.control_label: atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work

facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for G-8102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on G-8102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 31 August 2019 a planned critical control verification of G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work not effective.
